result.justification: The study presents a clear objective but lacks sufficient detail in the methodology to fully understand how the research was conducted.

evidence.quote: The aim of the present study is to apply the “Map-and-Mutate” strategy to the RNA-binding domain of the influenza virus NS1 protein (NS1-RBD) in order to identify novel targets for antiviral strategies.
Using influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 as a model, we found that mutations at positions 102, 121, 171, 175, and 184 significantly impaired viral replication in vitro.
